issues.description: Constructor parameter order for class Meal is inconsistent between artifacts. The problem statement UML and the solution implementation declare the constructor as Meal(String name, String[] ingredients) (name first). The template repository's Meal.java defines the constructor with the parameters reversed: public Meal(String[] ingredients, String name) (ingredients first). This mismatch will cause sample usage in Main (which instantiates Meal with the name as the first argument) to be incompatible with the template and can produce compilation errors or confusion for students.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the constructor in the template Meal.java to match the problem statement and solution: declare it as public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients) { this.name = name; this.ingredients = ingredients; }. Ensure parameter order is (name, ingredients) so the commented example in Main (new Meal("name", new String[]{...})) and the UML/specification are consistent.
